visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of a white pot on an induction stove. Inside, a variety of colorful vegetables including corn, tomatoes, onions, and bay leaves are simmering in water. The lighting is bright and clean, typical of a modern kitchen setting. (2) A female hand enters the frame, holding a small white porous packet, which it gently drops into the boiling vegetable mixture. A metal ladle is then used to push the packet down and stir the contents slightly. (3) The hand reappears to place a decorative white lid with a gold star-shaped knob onto the pot, covering the simmering soup. (4) The lid is lifted to reveal the cooked soup, and the ladle scoops up some of the now golden-yellow broth. (5) The scene shifts to the hand using the ladle to press a used broth bag over a metal strainer into a stainless steel bowl, extracting every drop of flavor. (6) A close-up shows the ladle scooping the clear, vibrant yellow broth from the bowl. (7) The hand pours the cooked vegetables from a strainer back into the white pot. (8) Finally, a black blender is shown on the counter, actively mixing a brown vegetable puree, with some motion blur indicating the high speed of the blades.

It demonstrates how to creatively use leftover vegetables and simple broth packets to create a high-quality, 'golden' vegetable stock, emphasizing zero waste by blending the remains into a puree.
